# QR Code generator library (vendored)

Project Nayuki's QR Code generator, C++ edition: `qrcodegen.hpp` and
`qrcodegen.cpp`, unmodified. SeventhSlide uses it for one thing, the code on
Settings > Web Remote that a phone's camera opens the remote with
(`src/app/qr_code.cpp`).
